about: Every number carries a tag. [П] = from a cited source; [В] = estimate (вывод/оценка) by the author of this module, order of magnitude only, NOT calibrated on gauge records. A value of null means unknown.

rho_air.tag: [П] ISA sea-level air density (ISO 2533); at 1600 m it is ~15 % lower, ignored [В]

drag_coefficient.tag: [П] bulk wind-stress drag coefficient of order 1.2e-3..1.3e-3 for U10 < 11 m/s (Large & Pond 1981, J. Phys. Oceanogr. 11)

gamma2.tag: [П] tilt factor 1 + k2 - h2 for the body tide (Pugh & Woodworth 2014, Sea-Level Science, ch. 3)

eq_amp_M2.tag: [П] equilibrium tide amplitude, Cartwright & Tayler 1971 (latitude factor cos^2 lat)

eq_amp_S2.tag: [П] equilibrium tide amplitude, Cartwright & Tayler 1971 (latitude factor cos^2 lat)

eq_amp_K1.tag: [П] equilibrium tide amplitude, Cartwright & Tayler 1971 (latitude factor sin 2 lat)

eq_amp_O1.tag: [П] equilibrium tide amplitude, Cartwright & Tayler 1971 (latitude factor sin 2 lat)

nodal_factors.tag: [В] nodal corrections omitted: changes amplitudes by up to ~4 % (M2) and ~11 % (K1), irrelevant at mm..cm scale

lapse_rate.tag: [П] ICAO standard atmosphere lapse rate (ISO 2533); real mountain lapse rates vary 0.004..0.008

ddf_ice.tag: [В] inside the ice range 6.6..20 reviewed by Hock 2003, J. Hydrology 282:104-115 [П]; not calibrated for Tien Shan

temp_peak_local_hour.tag: [В] typical hour of daily air-temperature maximum over land

t_mean_monthly.tag: [В] approximate climatology, order of magnitude; replace with station normals
